record.field: Order confirmed: one parcel per vendor
Order paid, or confirmed to pay at the door

Create one parcel per vendor, at the price of delivery paid for it. Choose who delivers from the form of the vendor and their zones: the vendor, an OCD courier, an agency, or the OCD stock. Tell each vendor the parcel to prepare.
Tested code of OCD Live, Sales and Inventory.
Parcel not ready: remind the vendor, then alert the dispatch
After the time to prepare a parcel, then after the alert delay (Settings)
The parcels still « to prepare » by a vendor.
Remind the vendor and note « Reminded » on the parcel. Still not ready: urgent activity for the dispatch and message in the channel of the deliveries; an OCD courier can take the parcel over.
Scheduled task, activities and team channels.
Parcel on the way: send the code to the customer
When the parcel is « on the way ».
Create a code of 4 digits, different for each parcel. Send it to the customer; hide it from the team and from the courier.
At the last wrong code allowed (Settings)
When too many wrong codes are typed.
Lock the parcel: it cannot be « delivered » any more without the team. Activity for the dispatch.
When the last attempt fails (customer absent or unreachable).
Send the parcel back to the vendor or to the OCD stock. When the customer paid online: the credit note to refund. Tell the customer.
Tested code of OCD Live, Inventory and Invoicing.
The parcel is delivered with the right code
The customers who agreed to the messages.
Thank the customer; the tracking page lets them rate the order or ask for a return.
Vendor live: tell the visitors who asked
When the live of the vendor starts
The visitors who asked « Tell me » on the boutique of the vendor.
Tell them that the vendor is live, with the link of the boutique.
Product back: tell the customers who asked
When a colour or a size sold out is back in stock
As soon as the stock comes back, and every 30 minutes.
The customers who asked « Tell me when it is back » on the page of the product.
Tell them on WhatsApp, with the link of the product in this colour and this size.
Parcel delivered: the share of the vendor
The parcel is delivered with the right code
When the parcel is « delivered », code checked.
Bill of the vendor: their sales minus the commission, plus their delivery minus the share of OCD. When the vendor kept the cash: it is withheld from the next payout.
Tested code of OCD Live, Purchase and Invoicing.
Prepare the payouts of the vendors
Every day, for the vendors whose payout day comes (Settings)
The bills of the parcels confirmed by code, not paid out yet.
Add up the bills of each vendor, minus what is withheld. Prepare the payouts for the team to check; below the minimum, it waits for the next one.
Code of OCD Live, Purchase and Invoicing.
